★Request
Display Satono Diamond (Summer School Uniform), Satono Crown (Summer School Uniform), Kiseki (Summer School Uniform)
(And, then...?)
Let's have our rematch in three weeks, then! Looking forward to it!

Because I couldn't help wishing for it too.
Wishing for her running to take true shape—and wanting to witness that very moment.

Kiseki will surely... do something "exciting" again.
Another trick that makes everyone watching lean forward in anticipation.

(Bet everything on this one strike!
—Seize the flag for a comeback!!)

Ah, ...thank goodness, Trainer!
I'm having a rematch soon! Won't you come watch me again?!

Previously on our story! Kiseki, a manga-loving Umamusume,
met a Trainer who was captivated by her running.
And then, she invited her to a mock race she'd be running in!

I-I'm fine, really! I've been wide awake since last night...!
I-I'm a little anxious, but I've been super thrilled the whole time too!!

Unable to join the battle among the frontrunners, Kiseki fell back.
...She failed to make any kind of notable splash.

"Won't you let me help you!"
"Please allow me to help you!"

Because if the protagonist doesn't make a move, the story won't start!
If I don't chase my dreams, there's no victory at the end of the track!!

And the young lady of the Satono family isn't the only one to watch.
Vivlos is also seen as a strong contender on the Tiara route.
I know I can... become the main character...!

Called by the starter Umamusume, Kiseki
heads toward her designated position like the others.

Next time, I'll definitely make it an exciting race!
I'll win, and I'll become the hero of this story!
(H-Huh...? What—?)

This setup feels just like a manga cliffhanger... Makes you excited, right?
Like, "How is Kiseki going to take down this formidable rival?"... or something.
Dammit......!!

(I really thought I could show them. I wanted to show them!
A spectacle where I become the protagonist in the most exciting race ever...!)

I can't just sit here sulking!
A real manga protagonist—would at least try for revenge!

T-That's not how it goes...
If I were the protagonist, I'd win. I'd win, and then—
And then, she invited him to a mock race she'd be running in!

Whew... haaah...! 
Now this is what I call a truly prestigious lineup...!! Whew...!

Kiseki is currently running second from last.
...She's way back. Did she miss the start?

She may not have had a standout moment this time.
However, her determination in "challenging powerful rivals"—

Haa... hah......... hah—
Even though they finally let me join their mock race...!
Alright... Now all that's left is to ask the Trainer again...

(Then I've got no choice but to catch them off guard with an unexpected ploy!
Shake up the strong, seize the opening... and turn it into the protagonist's victory!)
Uuugh...... How pathetic......
...Eighth place...

Time for a sprint duel! I'll slip right through the gap as they mark each other!
Rattle them, and pull off the win before they can react! ...Haaaaaaah!!

(Run like the wind, me!
Kick off a climax worthy of a center color spread! And then—)

(I knew there was a huge difference in our abilities.
Still, I begged and pleaded to make this race happen.)

A spark of resolve lights up in Kiseki's eyes.
Her gaze is fixed... on the narrow opening between the two runners ahead.

(To you, who felt that thrill from watching me.
To you, who became my reader.)

C-Catch up! Overtake them! You can do this, me!!
Haaaaah...... Yaaaaaaaahaaaaaaaah—!!

(The ones right in front of me are all fierce rivals who excel at spurting...!
If I take them head-on from the front, it'll just lead to a "classic defeat trope".)

Oh, looks like there's an uncontracted Umamusume running too.
Her position looks pretty rough, though... Heh, running without a plan is just youthful folly.

She said it herself: "I want to thrill people with my running."
If so, she must have a strategy in mind to defeat these formidable rivals.

Looking out the window, I saw Kiseki desperately bowing her head
to the girls she'd just raced against today. And then, her eyes sparkling—
And the track falls silent—the gates burst open!!

...Yet in reality, no comeback story ever started,
and it was just a booorrring race...! I couldn't excite anyone at all—

What an incredible lineup... Satono Crown, who placed 3rd in the Derby,
and Satono Diamond, the prodigy debuting this year...

Satono Diamond and the other frontrunners keep a sharp eye on each other from the rear.
Both proud of their late bursts, they seem to be keeping each other in check.

Seeing her face contorted in frustration after the mock race,
I ran all over the academy, desperate to speak with her.
